'''2012 Canadian Nationals Tom Graham DS Imperial Law''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Graham]] at [[2012 Canadian Nationals]] (Nationals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Law]]
* '''Username:''' SWCCGtom
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Nationals
